justification: Assessment reported INVALID at step 0038 ('alpha_1 is the set of automorphisms of M_{(1,2)}'), which is exactly the ground-truth flawed claim. Its core argument is the same structural one: every element of gamma_1 = beta_1 x beta_2 is a block-respecting direct product pi_1 x pi_2, so no block-mixing automorphism of M_{(1,2)} can ever lie in alpha_1 or the group it generates; it names the transposition of a vertex of H_1 with a vertex of H_2 as the witness. It adds a valid cardinality argument (|alpha_1| <= n^6 while |Aut(M)| can be superpolynomial). Different-but-valid witness for the same claim, so matching.
